title: Engine-free locale resolution contract for the Godot port

reference.note: The frozen browser build is the only source of strings. If this hash stops matching, the reference moved and this contract has to be re-derived by a human — the drift test fails on purpose.

fallbackEvidence: js/i18n.js:1408-1414 — t() is `DICT[currentLang][key] ?? DICT.it[key] ?? key`, and `let currentLang = "en"` (js/i18n.js:1398). Falling back to Italian is deliberate in the reference; falling back to the raw key is what the AI_LEGGENDA_NAME bug looked like on screen.

unknownLocale.evidence: js/i18n.js:1400-1402 — setLang(lang) sets currentLang = DICT[lang] ? lang : "it", silently. Measured against the live module for de/fr/es/zz: getLang() === "it" for all four.
unknownLocale.consequence: A locale the reference does not have is NOT a missing string: it is a request that the reference answers in Italian. The port must do the same and must not invent a table.

absentLocales.evidence: js/i18n.js contains exactly two table blocks, `it:` (line 2) and `en:` (line 699); there is no `de` block anywhere in js/**, index.html or styles.css.
absentLocales.rule: recorded missing, never machine-invented: a German-facing string is translated only when a human supplies it; until then the fallback chain answers, exactly as the reference does.

placeholder.substitution: for each param, replaceAll(`{name}`, String(value)) — js/i18n.js:1411-1413
placeholder.unbound: left in the output verbatim, braces included (the reference leaves them on screen too)
placeholder.rule: a message id that carries placeholders must arrive with its parameters; an id alone cannot fill them

controlMsg.evidence: js/game.js:455-456 — `const position = … ? t("roleBackPos") : t("roleNetPos"); addEvent(state, t("controlMsg", { position }))`. The port stores `controlMsg:<role id>` because the sim may not call t() (simulation-port-boundary.md §2).

pointYou.evidence: js/game.js:2110 — `state.pointMessage = `${t("pointYou")}${reason ? ` · ${reason}` : ""}``, with `reason` already rendered at the call site (js/game.js:2154-2180).

pointOpp.evidence: js/game.js:2110, the other branch of the same ternary.

derivedKeyFamilies.evidence: js/render.js and js/ui.js compose `athlete_${id}_name` and friends; scripts/i18n-audit.mjs:77-79 builds the same expected keys.
js/ui.js composes `ai_${id}_name`; the missing `ai_leggenda_name` is the AI_LEGGENDA_NAME bug (git 1652240).
outfit name keys are already full keys in the data; scripts/i18n-audit.mjs:84-86.
objective titles are composed from the def ids; scripts/i18n-audit.mjs:87.

invariants: Every key of the fallback locale exists in every locale of `locales` (key parity). The reference currently has full parity: 688 keys in `it`, 688 in `en`.
A key uses the same placeholder set in every locale: a translation that drops {n} prints a half sentence, one that invents a placeholder leaves braces on screen.
Every id the ported simulation can emit resolves to a string in the requested locale or, failing that, in the fallback locale — never to the id itself.

Every runtime-composed key family in `derivedKeyFamilies` exists, in every locale. These are the keys no one reads while writing them: they only appear on screen, in match, for one combination of data.
